create_mp3d_acoustic_config: create an Mp3dMaterialConfigGenerator instance to generate MP3D acoustic material properties JSON
generate_acoustic_material_json: generate a JSON file with acoustic material coefficients, labels, damping, density, and speed for MP3D
randomize_acoustic_coefficients: randomize acoustic material absorption, scattering, and transmission coefficients with Gaussian noise
get_acoustic_label_mapping: get the mapping of acoustic material labels to semantic scene categories for MP3D environments
get_acoustic_coeff_mapping: get the default or randomized acoustic material coefficient mapping for absorption, scattering, and transmission
